fightSong.title: Rock and Roll
fightSong.lyrics: On the lake, in the snow / Cleveland rocks and rolls / Turn it up to eleven / Rockers taking their toll!

stadium.name: The Garage
stadium.tradition: The Power Chord — a local guitarist shreds a 30-second riff pre-game. If they nail the solo, the team is 12-3 historically. If they miss, we blame the lake.

fanCulture.description: They wear dog masks and leather jackets. After turnovers they howl then air-guitar. They've suffered, they've stayed, they'll outlast you.
fanCulture.tailgate: In the Muni Lot at 7am, in December, with a full band.

rivalries.name: The Rust Belt Classic
rivalries.narrative: They smelt steel, we invented rock. Both hurt.

rivalries.name: The Ohio Jam
rivalries.narrative: Cincinnati flies pigs, we fly the flag for rock.

paAnnouncer.firstDownCall: First down Cleveland! Turn it up!
paAnnouncer.touchdownCall: ROCKER TOUCHDOWN! That's a hit single!

cityFlavor: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame, lake effect snow, and relentless loyalty. We boo because we care, we stay because we're family.
